title: 第013章 婚事第014章 名珍
lines: 一尺，一寸，一厘。
陈孤舟就这么看着刀尖，刺破胸口皮肤，分开血肉。
‘年轻人有骨气’的词条天赋，始终没有发挥作用。
终于在最后一刻。
他将胸膛一挺，导致刻刀往边上偏了一寸。
哒！
刀尖刺在了胸骨上。
霎时。
陈孤舟周身骨骼一震，应激般劈啪作响。彷佛雷霆震怒，爆发一缕缕细小微弱的骨气。
那骨气成千上万，比毫毛丝还细。
却在瞬间汇作一股，无孔不入，从内部、根源上斩断了内气所化的无形刀锋。
哗啦~~
鬼刀内气土崩瓦解，彷佛熊孩子遇到严父，瞬间龟缩回窍穴之内。
只留下七条连通双臂的血色经脉。
“成了！”
陈孤舟露出笑容，闭目细细体会。一股强大的气流游走周身，逐渐融入血肉筋骨，炼化玲珑七窍中的内气。
“我想的果然没错！人之一身，由肌肉、筋骨、血液组成。气血所转化的内气，只占身体三分之一，始终不及骨骼内的本源力量。”
“当然，能这么顺利，还多亏了《灵蛇吐息法》对内气的精妙掌控。”
陈孤舟志得意满。
如今双臂七窍已开，雕龙鬼刀大成，距离圆满境界只差一步。
并且激活了有骨气的根骨潜力，内气源源不绝壮大，陈孤舟也不知道自己现在属于什么层次。
想来。
应该比绝大部分通脉境界强吧？
“相比正常修行雕龙鬼刀之人，我已经领先许多。只待内气通达百脉，便可展望先天极境！”
走出静室，仰望璀璨夜空。
他对未来充满了期待。
模拟第8年。
摆脱了血肉畸变的隐患，陈孤舟的修为稳中求进。
内气逐渐充盈，在七十条经脉内流淌，平静的身体下隐藏着一股强大的力量。
也就是在这一年。
一桩麻烦事登门了。
其实也并非什么大麻烦，只是老一辈人的尿性，见他已经二十有三，要求他成家立业，找个合适的人家成亲。
为此。
雕龙一脉的老人都动了起来，多方奔走，为他寻找门当户对的女子。
陈孤舟推脱不过，只得暂时应下。
但只答应见上一面。
如今的陈孤舟，身份、地位、能力、潜力，皆是人中俊杰。
此事自然引来不少关注。
最终一名柳姓女子脱颖而出，得周雕龙首肯。
对方是江淮有名的商贾之家女子，比陈孤舟小六岁，自小知书达理，容貌周正，一看便是有福之人。
若无意外。
这场亲事几乎已是定下了。
content_en:
One foot, one inch, one centimeter.
Chen Guzhou just looked at the tip of the knife, piercing the skin on his chest and separating the flesh and blood.
The talent of the entry "Young people with backbone" never came into play.
Finally at the last minute.
He pushed out his chest, causing the carving knife to move an inch to the side.
clatter!
The tip of the knife stabbed his sternum.
Instantly.
Chen Guzhou's bones shook and crackled like stress. It was as if the thunder was furious, erupting into wisps of tiny and weak bones.
There are thousands of bones, thinner than hair.
However, they gathered together in an instant, penetrating all pervasive, and cutting off the invisible blade formed by the inner energy from the inside and from the root.
Wow~~
The inner Qi of the Ghost Sword collapsed, as if a naughty child encountered a strict father and instantly shrank back into its aperture.
Only seven bloody meridians connecting the arms were left.
"It's done!"
Chen Guzhou smiled and closed his eyes to take in the experience. A powerful flow of air travels throughout the body, gradually blending into flesh, blood, muscles and bones, refining the inner energy in the exquisite seven orifices.
"What I thought is indeed correct! The human body is composed of muscles, bones, and blood. The internal energy transformed by the energy and blood only accounts for one-third of the body, and it is never as good as the original power in the bones."
"Of course, it was so smooth thanks to the exquisite control of the inner energy of the "Spiritual Snake Breathing Technique"."
Chen Guzhou was very proud.
Now the seven orifices of both arms have been opened, and the Dragon-Carved Ghost Sword has been completed. It is only one step away from the perfect state.
Moreover, the potential of the bones with backbone has been activated, and the inner energy is growing continuously. Chen Guzhou does not know what level he belongs to now.
Think about it.
It should be stronger than most Tongmai realms, right?
"Compared to the normal people who practice the Dragon Carved Ghost Sword, I am already much ahead. As long as the inner Qi reaches the hundred meridians, I can look forward to the innate extreme realm!"
Step out of the quiet room and look up at the bright night sky.
He is full of expectations for the future.
Simulation Year 8.
Getting rid of the hidden danger of flesh and blood distortion, Chen Guzhou's cultivation level is stable and improving.
The inner Qi gradually fills up and flows through the seventy meridians. There is a powerful force hidden under the calm body.
That is in this year.
A trouble has arrived.
In fact, it's not a big trouble, it's just the urination of the older generation. Seeing that he was already in his twenties, they asked him to start a family and find a suitable family to get married to.
to this end.
The old men of Diaolong's lineage all started to move, running around in various directions to find a suitable woman for him.
Chen Guzhou couldn't shirk it, so he had to agree temporarily.
But he only agreed to meet once.
Today's Chen Guzhou, with his identity, status, ability, and potential, is all outstanding among people.
This matter naturally attracted a lot of attention.
In the end, a woman named Liu stood out and won Zhou Diaolong's approval.
The other party is a woman from a famous merchant family in Jianghuai. She is six years younger than Chen Guzhou. She has been well-educated and sensible since she was a child. She has a good appearance. At first glance, she is a blessed person.
If there are no accidents.
The marriage has almost been decided.
